description: This header file declares functions and structures related to managing command aliases, including lookup, quoting command lines, splitting command lines, error handling, and listing aliases.

methods.name: alias_lookup
methods.description: Looks up the command associated with a given alias.

methods.name: quote_cmdline
methods.description: Quotes command-line arguments so they can be safely parsed.

methods.name: split_cmdline
methods.description: Splits a command line into arguments.

methods.name: split_cmdline_strerror
methods.description: Returns an error message for a failed split_cmdline operation.
